finding.mechanism: EffectJournal normal finalization requires VERIFIED plus ok=true for positive credit, while recovery reconstruction used outcome.ok alone; a non-VERIFIED persisted outcome carrying inconsistent ok=true could therefore be re-entered as positive learning evidence after restart
finding.risk: restart-induced learning contamination without external effect replay

source_candidate.contract: positive recovery causal credit requires effect status VERIFIED and outcome ok=true; DENIED, FAILED, STALE_OUTCOME and UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART remain zero-credit even if an inconsistent receipt says ok=true

truth_boundary: The patch and regression obligation are durable source evidence only. No CI pre-step failure, source inspection, or local mechanism reasoning is represented as exact ClayVerse runtime PASS.
